title: Is n8n Automation Free? What Self-Hosting Costs
summary: n8n automation connects apps through visual workflows on your server or cloud. Find pricing details and free version information.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Answers reflect the n8n documentation and pricing pages as read on 24 November 2026. Check them again before you sign anything.


### Cost and licence


Is n8n really free? The self-hosted Community Edition costs nothing to download and run, but you pay for the server, backups, upgrades and whoever is on call. Cloud is a paid, execution-based plan. Treat "free" as the licence price only.


Is n8n open source? Not in the strict sense. n8n publishes its source under a fair-code licence, the Sustainable Use License. It lets you read, modify and self-host it for internal use but restricts selling it as a service.


If your policy says "OSI-approved licences only", this fails the check, so have legal read the licence text first.


### Replacing other tools


Can n8n replace Zapier or Make? For most workflows, yes, provided someone on your team will own it.


The constraint is operational, not functional: n8n gives you more control over branching, data handling and hosting, and in exchange you take on maintenance that a fully managed tool does for you.


Migrate one low-risk workflow first and compare the real effort.


### Skills and integrations


Do I need to code to use n8n? No, but you'll be more effective if you can read code. The visual editor covers common work, and the Code node, which accepts JavaScript and Python, handles what it doesn't.


Expect to meet expressions and JSON early, and plan for at least one person who is comfortable debugging them.


How many integrations does n8n have? It ships a large library of built-in nodes for common services, and the HTTP Request node reaches any service that exposes an API.


The library's size matters less than whether your specific systems are covered, so check the node list for each tool you depend on and test authentication before committing.
